_comment: Test vectors for EPUB Annotations selector generation and resolution (docs/design/06-annotations.md §5, §6, §14). The book is cfi-sample.epub. `cfi` is the position (UTF-16 offsets, counted on the rendered tree without script elements and template contents). `css` / `start` / `end` are the CssSelector and its TextPositionSelector refinement (Unicode code points into the textContent of the selected element, counted on the source tree, which has the scripts). `exact` / `prefix` / `suffix` are the TextQuoteSelector (code points of the body's textContent; 32 code points of context, grown by 32 until the quote is unique). Bookmarks have no quote.
